SELECT 'cash_rake_accrual'::text AS source_type,
    s.id AS source_id,
    s.rake_record_id,
    NULL::uuid AS tournament_id,
    s.player_id,
    s.club_id,
    s.union_id,
    s.coordinator_union_id,
    s.earned_at,
    s.rake_credit,
    s.contract
   FROM accounting_cash_rake_sources s
  WHERE fn_ca_launch_accounting_accepts(s.club_id, s.earned_at)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'tournament_fee_accrual'::text AS source_type,
    s.id AS source_id,
    s.rake_record_id,
    s.tournament_id,
    s.player_id,
    s.club_id,
    s.union_id,
    s.coordinator_union_id,
    rs.recognized_at AS earned_at,
    s.rake_credit,
    s.contract
   FROM accounting_tournament_fee_sources s
     JOIN accounting_tournament_recognized_sources rs ON rs.source_id = s.id AND rs.tournament_id = s.tournament_id
     JOIN accounting_tournament_fee_recognitions r ON r.tournament_id = s.tournament_id
  WHERE fn_ca_launch_accounting_accepts(s.club_id, s.charged_at) AND fn_ca_launch_accounting_accepts(s.club_id, rs.recognized_at) AND rs.disposition = 'earned'::text AND r.status = 'recognized'::text AND rs.rake_credit = s.rake_credit AND rs.recognized_at = r.recognized_at AND NOT s.union_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.union_id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_accepts(p_club_id uuid, p_earned_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN b.cutoff IS NULL THEN true ELSE p_earned_at IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(p_earned_at) AND p_earned_at>=b.cutoff END
 FROM (SELECT public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_cutoff('club',p_club_id) cutoff)b
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_cutoff(p_kind text, p_id uuid)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT cutoff_at FROM public.ca_launch_accounting_boundaries WHERE scope_kind=p_kind AND scope_id=p_id AND undone_at IS NULL
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_club_settlement_floor_week(p_club_id uuid)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN public.fn_union_week_start(f.earliest_period_start) < f.earliest_period_start
      THEN public.fn_union_week_start(public.fn_union_week_start(f.earliest_period_start)+interval '8 days')
    ELSE public.fn_union_week_start(f.earliest_period_start)
  END
  FROM public.club_settlement_floor f
  WHERE f.club_id = p_club_id
$function$
